name: Goldwin Inc.
summary: Goldwin Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells apparel in Japan. The company offers jacket/vest, shell, down jacket/padded, fleece, rainwear, and coat; shirts/polo shirts, sweatshirts/trainers, t-shirt, cut and sew, sweaters and cardigans, tank tops/bra tops, long-sleeved t-shirt, one piece, and camisole; long pants, skirt, tights/leggings, and short/half pants. It also provides swimwear, swimsuit, trunks, rash guard; underwear/tights; accessories, including socks, cap, knit beanie, hat, swim cap, gloves, towel, pouch, goggles, sunglasses, bandana/handkerchief, hair band, belt, key ring, baby/kids items, head cover, wallets/pass cases, scarves/neck covers, and other products; bag…
